tooltip.anyastorage.element_leaf.1: Unlocks a leafy look for your backpack. You can switch back to it in Wardrobe.
tooltip.anyastorage.element_leaf.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft this binding with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.element_stone.1: Wear the Stone backpack for extra armor (default +2) when elemental effects are enabled.
tooltip.anyastorage.element_stone.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft this binding with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.element_diamond.1: Wear the Diamond-bound backpack for extra armor (default +4) when elemental effects are enabled.
tooltip.anyastorage.element_diamond.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft this binding with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.element_magma.1: Wear the Magma backpack to take less fire damage (default 20% less) when elemental effects are enabled.
tooltip.anyastorage.element_magma.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft this binding with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.element_water.1: Wear the Water backpack to swim faster (default +10%) when elemental effects are enabled.
tooltip.anyastorage.element_water.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft this binding with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_bow_cat.1: Unlocks a backpack skin with cat ears and a pink bow.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_bow_cat.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft the patch with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_midnight_cat.1: Unlocks a dark cat-ear skin with lavender trim.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_midnight_cat.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft the patch with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_spooky.1: Unlocks a backpack skin with a ghost on the front pocket.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_spooky.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft the patch with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_cute_spooky.1: Unlocks a backpack skin with a pink-cheeked ghost.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_cute_spooky.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft the patch with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_futuristic.1: Unlocks a blue backpack skin with cyan circuitry.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_futuristic.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft the patch with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_galaxy.1: Unlocks a starry backpack skin that can twinkle while worn.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_galaxy.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft the patch with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_oak.1: Unlocks an oak-leaf skin that can shed leaves as you walk.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_oak.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft the patch with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_cherry.1: Unlocks a cherry-leaf skin that can shed pink leaves as you walk.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_cherry.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft the patch with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_dark_oak.1: Unlocks a dark oak skin that can shed leaves as you walk.
tooltip.anyastorage.skin_dark_oak.2: Right-click a placed backpack or craft the patch with a backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.pickup_upgrade.1: Moves filtered items from your inventory into the bag. An empty filter matches stored stacks.
tooltip.anyastorage.pickup_upgrade.2: Install in a free backpack upgrade slot or right-click a placed backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.feeding_upgrade.1: Feeds you bread and other plain foods when you can use all their hunger points.
tooltip.anyastorage.feeding_upgrade.2: Install in a free backpack upgrade slot or right-click a placed backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.refill_upgrade.1: Tops up existing hotbar stacks with matching items from the bag.
tooltip.anyastorage.refill_upgrade.2: Install in a free backpack upgrade slot or right-click a placed backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.crafting_upgrade.1: Adds a button to open a 3×3 crafting grid using your inventory.
tooltip.anyastorage.crafting_upgrade.2: Install in a free backpack upgrade slot or right-click a placed backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.smelting_upgrade.1: Smelts items on the bag's smelting filter using coal or charcoal stored inside.
tooltip.anyastorage.smelting_upgrade.2: Install in a free backpack upgrade slot or right-click a placed backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.compacting_upgrade.1: Press Compact to pack nine plain materials into an ingot or block, one recipe at a time.
tooltip.anyastorage.compacting_upgrade.2: Install in a free backpack upgrade slot or right-click a placed backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.resupply_upgrade.1: Select an empty hotbar slot, then press Resupply to move a tool or sword into it.
tooltip.anyastorage.resupply_upgrade.2: Install in a free backpack upgrade slot or right-click a placed backpack.
tooltip.anyastorage.storage_core.1: One core and four Nether Stars go into the optional UwU Storage Cube recipe.
tooltip.anyastorage.storage_core.2: Craft the core with eight diamond blocks around a netherite block.
tooltip.anyastorage.dragon_victory_token: Earn one by defeating the Ender Dragon in Survival during an End fight.
Use four to craft the UwU Storage Cube when the server enables its token recipe.
